title: The Y-partial derivative annihilates a degree-n binary form after n+1 iterations
statement: For every natural number n and every P : BinaryForm ℂ n, let D_Y denote formal polynomial differentiation in variable 1. Then D_Y^(n+1) applied to the underlying polynomial of P is zero.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[n + 1] P.val) = 0
